risk_test_results.test_name: TEST-RC-01: Position Sizing Available Margin Gate
risk_test_results.requirement: Sizer must return 0 quantity if required margin exceeds available margin
risk_test_results.evidence: BTCUSD required margin $16.20 on $10 account sized to qty=0

risk_test_results.test_name: TEST-RC-02: Maximum Leverage (5x) and 20% Single-Asset Exposure Cap
risk_test_results.requirement: Single position margin must not exceed 20% of account capital ($2.00)
risk_test_results.evidence: XRPUSDT sized 3 units with $0.80 margin (<= $2.00 cap)

risk_test_results.test_name: TEST-RC-03: Daily Loss Limit Circuit Breaker Activation
risk_test_results.requirement: Must reject new entries when daily loss reaches or exceeds limit ($1.00)
risk_test_results.evidence: Intent rejected with reason: Daily Loss Limit hit: $1.20 >= max allowed $1.00

risk_test_results.requirement: SL for long must be strictly below fill price; dynamic re-anchor prevents tick-1 exit

risk_test_results.test_name: TEST-RC-05: Reduce-Only Exit Behavior & Exposure Elimination
risk_test_results.requirement: Reduce-only order must close/shrink position and never flip exposure
risk_test_results.evidence: Executed SELL reduce-only order. Active positions remaining: 0

risk_test_results.test_name: TEST-RC-06: Residual Bracket Order Cleanup upon Reduce-Only Exit
risk_test_results.requirement: Native bracket orders must be cancelled when position closes
risk_test_results.evidence: broker.bracket_orders expunged DOGEUSDT upon market exit fill

risk_test_results.requirement: Guardian must disallow averaging down or submitting duplicate orders on active positions
risk_test_results.evidence: Guardian rejected duplicate: Duplicate Position Guard: Active position already exists for XRPUSDT.

risk_test_results.test_name: TEST-RC-08: Daily Loss State Recovery Across Process Restarts
risk_test_results.requirement: Restart must restore day-start equity and accumulated loss from persistent storage
Zero orders allowed once breaker trips until UTC midnight rollover
